name: Gogolook Co., Ltd.
summary: Gogolook Co., Ltd., established in 2012 and headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, operates across global markets, focusing on communication fraud prevention, financial technology, and SaaS risk management. Among its key offerings is Whoscall, a prominent call identification application that utilizes AI technology and an extensive database to instantly recognize unknown callers and effectively block unsolicited calls. Call Defender serves as another robust call blocker and caller ID tool, designed to detect and prevent spam communications. For message security, the Message Checker application assists in scam detection, complemented by Auntie Meiyu, a chatbot that verifies suspicious messages instantly. Beyond these consumer tools, Gogolook collaborates with banks to facilitate a range of financial services, including credit card processing, various loan types, digital banking solutions, mortgages, and other financial products. Moreover, the company delivers enterprise-level solutions such as the Watchmen Reputation Protection Service, which proactively identifies and thwarts fraud for governmental agencies, financial entities, and e-commerce businesses. Its Identity Suit provides digital identification capabilities for cryptocurrency platforms, e-commerce sites, and financial institutions. Additionally, Caller Database Solutions offers real-time detection of unidentified callers and safeguards against malicious communications. Lastly, Gogolook also developed GogoHR, an all-in-one resume assistant.
